subject: DI02005021

body.en:
Definition

Filtration separates suspended solids by passing fluid through a porous medium which retains particles directly or through a deposited cake.

Classification

  • Constant pressure:driving pressure held approximately fixed and rate usually decreases. Constant rate:flow fixed and required pressure usually increases as cake grows.
  • Surface/cake filtration and depth filtration differ; the equations here describe cake filtration.

Explanation

  • Media examples:cloth, wire mesh, porous paper and sintered materials. Required pore retention, permeability, strength, chemical/thermal compatibility and cleanability depend on service.
  • Filter aid such as approved diatomaceous earth/perlite can form a permeable precoat or be body-fed; it is not always an adsorbent and may contaminate a desired solid product.
  • Rm is medium resistance(m⁻¹); Rc is cake resistance(m⁻¹); specific cake resistance α is m/kg. For uniform incompressible cake, Rc=αms/A=αCV/A.
  • C is dry deposited solids per filtrate volume(kg/m³), not automatically slurry concentration.μ is fluid viscosity, A effective area and ΔP the driving pressure.

Limitations and safety

  • Dust from filter aids and pressure/vacuum equipment require approved containment; no improvised pressure filter.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Porous mediumમાંથી fluid પસાર કરી particlesને સીધા કે cakeથી રોકીને filtration થાય.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Constant pressureમાં pressure લગભગ સ્થિર, rate સામાન્ય રીતે ઘટે; constant rateમાં flow સ્થિર, cake વધતાં જરૂરી pressure વધે.
  • Surface/cake તથા depth filtration જુદાં; અહીંનાં equations cake filtration માટે છે.

સમજણ

  • Media:cloth, wire mesh, paper, sintered materials. Retention, permeability, strength, chemical/thermal compatibility તથા cleaning જરૂરી.
  • Approved diatomaceous earth/perliteથી permeable precoat/body feed મળે; હંમેશાં adsorbent નથી, desired solid productને contaminate કરી શકે.
  • Rm medium resistance(m⁻¹), Rc cake resistance(m⁻¹), α specific cake resistance(m/kg). Uniform incompressible cakeમાં Rc=αms/A=αCV/A.
  • C dry deposited solids/filtrate volume(kg/m³), સીધું slurry concentration નહીં.μ viscosity, A effective area, ΔP driving pressure.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Filter-aid dust તથા pressure/vacuum માટે approved containment; improvised pressure filter નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

For an incompressible cake at fixed pressure, the accumulated resistance causes filtrate rate to fall.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Assume constant pressure difference ΔP, area A, viscosity μ and medium resistance Rm; uniform incompressible cake with constant specific resistance α.Define C as dry deposited solids per filtrate volume.
  2. After filtrate volume V, cake dry mass Mc=CV.Cake resistance Rc=αMc/A=αCV/A.
  3. Darcy equation:dV/dt=AΔP/[μ(Rm+Rc)].Substitute Rc to obtain dV/dt=AΔP/[μ(Rm+αCV/A)].
  4. Invert to separate variables:dt=[μRm/(AΔP)+μαCV/(A²ΔP)]dV.
  5. Integrate from clean start(t=0, V=0):t=μRmV/(AΔP)+μαCV²/(2A²ΔP).The factor1/2 comes from ∫VdV=V²/2.
  6. For V>0, divide by V:t/V=B+KV, where B=μRm/(AΔP) and K=μαC/(2A²ΔP).Plot t/V vertically against V horizontally.
  7. Hence Rm=BAΔP/μ and α=2KA²ΔP/(μC).With t in s and V in m³, B has s/m³, K has s/m⁶, Rm m⁻¹ and α m/kg.
  8. Instantaneous rate is1/(B+2KV), not V/t.Compressible cake, varying pressure or a nonzero initial cake/time offset needs correction or another model.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

સ્થિર pressureએ incompressible cake વધતાં resistance વધે અને filtrate rate ઘટે.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Constant ΔP, A, μ, Rm તથા uniform incompressible cake/constant α માનો.C એટલે filtrate volume દીઠ deposited dry solids.
  2. Filtrate V પછી cake mass Mc=CV; Rc=αMc/A=αCV/A.
  3. Darcy:dV/dt=AΔP/[μ(Rm+Rc)]; Rc મૂકતાં dV/dt=AΔP/[μ(Rm+αCV/A)].
  4. Variables separate કરવા invert:dt=[μRm/(AΔP)+μαCV/(A²ΔP)]dV.
  5. Clean start(t=0, V=0)થી integrate:t=μRmV/(AΔP)+μαCV²/(2A²ΔP).∫VdV=V²/2થી1/2 આવે.
  6. V>0માં Vથી ભાગો:t/V=B+KV; B=μRm/(AΔP), K=μαC/(2A²ΔP).Vertical t/V સામે horizontal V plot કરો.
  7. અેથી Rm=BAΔP/μ, α=2KA²ΔP/(μC).t s, V m³માં B s/m³, K s/m⁶, Rm m⁻¹, α m/kg થાય.
  8. Instantaneous rate1/(B+2KV) છે, V/t નહીં.Compressible cake, varying ΔP કે initial cake/time offsetમાં correction/બીજો model જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

Constant-rate filtration maintains q=dV/dt while pressure rises with deposited cake resistance.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Assume constant filtrate volumetric rate q, area A, viscosity μ and medium resistance Rm, with a uniform incompressible cake having constant α and C.
  2. Cake dry mass is CV and cake resistance Rc=αCV/A.Darcy gives q=AΔP/[μ(Rm+αCV/A)].
  3. Rearrange for pressure:ΔP=μqRm/A+μαCqV/A².
  4. For clean start and constant q, V=qt.Substitute to get ΔP=μqRm/A+(μαCq²/A²)t.
  5. Thus ΔP versus t is a straight line.Intercept I=μqRm/A is the medium contribution; slope S=μαCq²/A² represents cake growth.
  6. If model-valid, Rm=IA/(μq) and α=SA²/(μCq²).Check I in Pa, S in Pa/s and q in m³/s.
  7. At t=0 only the clean medium term remains; pressure rises as cake grows.Constant rate must end or change mode before any authorised pressure limit is reached.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

q=dV/dt સ્થિર રાખતાં cake resistance વધવાથી pressure વધે.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Constant filtrate rate q, A, μ, Rm તથા uniform incompressible cake/constant α, C માનો.
  2. Cake dry mass CV, Rc=αCV/A; Darcy મુજબ q=AΔP/[μ(Rm+αCV/A)].
  3. Pressure માટે rearrange:ΔP=μqRm/A+μαCqV/A².
  4. Clean start/constant qમાં V=qt; substitute કરતાં ΔP=μqRm/A+(μαCq²/A²)t.
  5. અેથી ΔP–t straight line; intercept I=μqRm/A medium contribution, slope S=μαCq²/A² cake growth બતાવે.
  6. Model valid હોય તો Rm=IA/(μq), α=SA²/(μCq²).I Pa, S Pa/s, q m³/s લો.
  7. t=0એ clean medium term જ રહે; cake વધતાં pressure વધે.Authorised pressure limit પહેલાં constant-rate duty end/mode change કરવી જરૂરી.

body.en:
Definition

A batch pressure filter forming cakes between cloth-covered plates/frames.

Principle

  • Pressure drives liquid through cloth/support channels while solids build a cake.

Construction—detailed theory

A plate-and-frame filter press contains alternating plates and hollow frames clamped between end supports (1). Filter cloth lies against the drainage faces of the plates (2). The hollow frames create cake chambers (5), while aligned holes in the stack form slurry-feed passages (3). Channels behind the cloth lead filtrate to separate outlets (4).

A closing mechanism holds the stack against the intended pressure load, with approved pressure protection (6). Plate surfaces support the cloth and provide a liquid-drainage route; the cloth alone is not expected to span the chamber unsupported. The described arrangement is the plate-and-frame type; recessed-plate presses achieve cake spaces with a different plate shape.

Working—detailed theory

After the stack is correctly closed, slurry is supplied through the feed passages into the frame spaces. Pressure difference drives liquid through the cloth into the plate drainage channels. Solids initially retained by the medium begin to form a cake, which then acts as an additional filtering layer. Filtrate is collected without being mixed with the incoming slurry.

As cake thickness grows, cake resistance increases. Under constant pressure the filtrate rate generally falls; at constant rate the required pressure rises. When the permitted end condition is reached, feed is stopped and the unit is depressurised and isolated. The stack is then opened and cake removed before reassembly. Thus filtration is a batch cycle including non-filtering discharge/cleaning time.

Applications

  • Batch slurry clarification and recovery of valuable cakes.

Limitations and safety

  • Cyclic labour and cloth sealing; never open or tighten a pressurised stack.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Cloth-covered plates/frames વચ્ચે cake બનાવતું batch pressure filter.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Pressureથી liquid cloth/supportમાંથી જાય; solid cake બને.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Plate-and-frame pressમાં alternating plates તથા hollow frames end supports વચ્ચે clamp થાય છે (1). Platesની drainage faces પર cloth (2) રહે છે. Hollow frames cake chambers (5) બનાવે; aligned holes slurry-feed passages (3) બનાવે છે. Clothની પાછળના channels filtrateને અલગ outlets (4)માં પહોંચાડે છે.

Closing mechanism intended pressure load સામે stack બંધ રાખે અને approved protection (6) આપે છે. Plate surfaces clothને ટેકો તથા drainage route આપે; clothને unsupported આખા chamber પર રાખાતું નથી. આ plate-and-frame arrangement છે; recessed-plate pressમાં cake space plateના જુદા shapeથી બને છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Stack યોગ્ય રીતે બંધ થયા પછી slurry feed passagesથી frame spacesમાં ભરાય છે. Pressure difference liquidને clothમાંથી plate drainage channelsમાં લઈ જાય છે. Medium પર retained solids cake બનાવે; આ cake વધારાનું filtering layer બને છે. Filtrateને incoming slurry સાથે ભેળવ્યા વિના collect કરવામાં આવે છે.

Cake જાડું થતાં resistance વધે છે. Constant pressureમાં filtrate rate ઘટે; constant rateમાં required pressure વધે. Permitted end conditionએ feed બંધ કરીને depressurise/isolate કરાય છે. પછી stack ખોલી cake કાઢી ફરી assemble થાય. તેથી discharge/cleaningના non-filtering time સહિત આ batch cycle છે.

ઉપયોગો

  • Batch slurry clarification તથા valuable cake recovery.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Cyclic labour/cloth sealing જરૂરી. Pressurised stack ખોલવો/કસવો નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A continuously rotating cloth-covered drum filter partly immersed in slurry.

Principle

  • Vacuum across successive drum sectors draws filtrate and builds cake on the exterior.

Construction—detailed theory

A rotating perforated drum is covered with filter cloth and divided internally into sectors (1, 3). Its lower part dips into a slurry trough with suitable level and suspension control (2). Each sector communicates with a rotary valve that connects it to the appropriate vacuum or release service as it travels around the drum.

A vacuum receiver and filtrate line collect liquid separately from the vacuum source (4). Above the trough are designated cake-washing and dewatering regions where required (5). A scraper or other design-specific discharge device removes the cake (6), and cloth cleaning prepares the surface for reuse. The valve timing makes these successive operations possible on different sectors at the same time.

Working—detailed theory

As a sector enters the slurry, vacuum creates a pressure difference through the cloth. Liquid passes into the drum sector and receiver, while solids form a cake on the outer surface. Rotation carries the deposited cake out of the slurry; the vacuum connection is maintained during the designated formation and dewatering portions of the cycle.

Where washing is specified, wash liquid is applied to displace retained mother liquor, followed by further dewatering. Near discharge, the valve changes the sector condition so that the cake can be released and scraped off. The cleaned cloth returns to the trough and the cycle repeats. Drum speed, immersion, slurry properties and cake permeability determine cake thickness and throughput; rotation alone does not create the filtration pressure difference.

Applications

  • Continuous filtration of cake-forming slurries.

Limitations and safety

  • Needs suitable cake release; vacuum and rotating drum guarded. Vacuum vessels require certified design.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Slurryમાં અંશતઃ ડૂબેલો ફરતો cloth-covered drum filter.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Drum sectorsમાં vacuumથી filtrate ખેંચાય; બહાર cake બને.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Rotating perforated drum પર cloth હોય અને અંદર sectors બને છે (1, 3). તેનો lower part slurry trough (2)માં ડૂબે છે; level/suspension control હોય છે. દરેક sector rotary valve સાથે જોડાય છે જેથી drum ફરતાં યોગ્ય vacuum/release service મળી શકે.

Vacuum receiver/filtrate line (4) liquidને vacuum sourceથી અલગ collect કરે છે. Trough ઉપર જરૂરી washing/dewatering zones (5) હોય છે. Scraper કે design-specific device (6) cake દૂર કરે; cloth cleaningથી surface ફરી તૈયાર થાય. Valve timingથી જુદા sectors પર આ operations એક સમયે જુદા stagesમાં થાય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Sector slurryમાં આવે ત્યારે vacuumથી cloth પર pressure difference મળે છે. Liquid sector/receiverમાં જાય; solids outer surface પર cake બનાવે છે. Rotation cakeને slurryની બહાર લાવે; નિર્ધારિત formation/dewatering portions દરમિયાન vacuum connection રહે છે.

Washing હોય તો wash liquid retained mother liquorને displace કરે અને પછી વધારાનું dewatering થાય. Discharge પાસે valve sector condition બદલે જેથી cake release/scrape થઈ શકે. Clean cloth પાછું troughમાં આવી cycle ફરી કરે. Speed, immersion, slurry/cake permeability thickness/throughput નક્કી કરે; માત્ર rotationથી filtration ΔP બનતું નથી.

ઉપયોગો

  • Cake-forming slurryનું continuous filtration.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Cake release અનુકૂળ જોઈએ; vacuum/drum guarded. Certified vacuum vessel જરૂરી.

body.en:
Definition

A filter with hollow drainage leaves covered by porous media inside a vessel or slurry tank.

Principle

  • Fluid crosses leaf media into internal drainage; cake deposits outside.

Construction—detailed theory

In the pressure-leaf example, an enclosed vessel (1) houses several hollow supported leaves (2). Each leaf has a porous retaining medium on its outside (3) and an internal space for clear filtrate. Connections from the leaf interiors join a common filtrate manifold (5), kept separate from the slurry feed/drain arrangement (4).

The leaves provide a relatively large filtering area within the vessel. Their rigid supports prevent the medium from collapsing under the intended pressure difference. A designed cake-removal and cleaning arrangement (6) permits batch discharge after safe depressurisation. Pressure-leaf and vacuum-leaf systems use related principles, but the sketch specifically shows a pressure-vessel arrangement.

Working—detailed theory

Slurry fills the vessel around the leaves. Applied pressure forces liquid from the outside through the retaining medium into each hollow leaf. Retained solids accumulate as cake on the external filtering surfaces, while filtrate flows through the leaf interiors and common outlet manifold. Separate flow paths prevent deliberate mixing of filtrate with unfiltered slurry.

Cake growth increases resistance and changes the filtration rate or required pressure according to the operating mode. At the authorised endpoint, the unit is stopped, isolated and depressurised; remaining slurry is handled by its designed drain procedure. Cake is then released by the specified mechanical, vibratory or washing method. Cleaning and reassembly complete the batch; the leaf itself does not rotate like a drum filter.

Applications

  • Clarification and filtration with large area in a compact vessel.

Limitations and safety

  • Leafs need compatible media and accessible cleaning. Pressure/vacuum variants differ; do not confuse the two.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Vessel/tankમાં porous mediaથી ઢંકાયેલા hollow drainage leavesવાળું filter.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Fluid leaf media પાર કરી અંદરના drainageમાં જાય; cake બહાર બને.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Pressure-leaf exampleમાં enclosed vessel (1)ની અંદર hollow supported leaves (2) હોય છે. Leafની બહાર porous retaining medium (3) અને અંદર filtrate માટે space હોય છે. Leaf interiorsના connections common filtrate manifold (5)માં મળે, જે slurry feed/drain (4)થી અલગ છે.

Leavesથી vesselમાં relatively મોટું filtering area મળે છે. Rigid supports intended ΔP હેઠળ mediumને collapse થતું અટકાવે છે. Designed cake-removal/cleaning arrangement (6)થી safe depressurisation પછી batch discharge મળે. Vacuum-leaf પણ હોય છે, પરંતુ આ sketch pressure-vessel arrangementનું છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Slurry leavesની આસપાસ vesselમાં ભરાય છે. Applied pressureથી liquid બહારથી medium પાર કરી hollow leafમાં જાય છે. Retained solids external filtering surfaces પર cake બને; filtrate interiorsમાંથી common manifoldમાં જાય છે. અલગ pathsથી filtrate તથા unfiltered slurryનું mixing ટાળાય છે.

Cake વધતાં resistance તથા mode મુજબ rate/required pressure બદલાય છે. Authorised endpointએ stop, isolate/depressurise કરીને remaining slurry designed drainથી handle થાય. પછી specified mechanical, vibratory/washing methodથી cake release થાય. Cleaning/reassemblyથી batch પૂર્ણ થાય; leaf drum filterની જેમ ફરતું નથી.

ઉપયોગો

  • Compact vesselમાં વધુ areaથી clarification/filtration.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Compatible media/cleaning જરૂરી. Pressure તથા vacuum variants જુદાં છે.

body.en:
Definition

A rotating perforated basket with a retaining medium which dewaters a cake under centrifugal acceleration.

Principle

  • Outward liquid pressure drives filtration; this differs from a solid-bowl sedimenting centrifuge.

Construction—detailed theory

The filtering element is a perforated rotating basket lined with a suitable supported cloth or medium (1). A shaft, bearings and rated drive carry the basket (2), enclosed inside a protective casing with a lid interlock (3). An approved distributor supplies feed (4), while the stationary casing catches liquid leaving the basket and directs it to the filtrate outlet (5).

Solids form a cake against the inner retaining surface (6). Cake discharge may be manual after complete stopping or may use an engineered automatic arrangement. Basket strength, maximum speed and load balance are critical design constraints. This is a filtering centrifuge with a permeable basket, not a solid-bowl settling centrifuge in which liquid and solids separate without passing through a filter medium.

Working—detailed theory

Under approved balanced loading, rotation drives liquid and solids towards the basket wall. The outward pressure gradient forces liquid through the cake, cloth and basket perforations. Solids unable to pass the retaining surface remain inside and build a cake. Filtrate enters the surrounding stationary casing and leaves through its separate outlet.

Continued rotation can remove part of the liquid held in the cake; a designed wash may be applied where specified. Flow changes as cake thickness and liquid radii change, so a planar constant-pressure equation is not automatically valid. At the end the machine is stopped, zero speed verified and energy isolated before opening or cake removal. Never equate calculated centrifugal head with a universally constant pressure across a thick cake.

Applications

  • Dewatering crystalline/granular cakes that drain effectively.

Limitations and safety

  • Overspeed, unbalance and rotor failure are severe hazards. No bypassed interlock or improvised rotor.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Retaining mediumવાળી perforated rotating basket centrifugal accelerationથી cake dewater કરે.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Outward liquid pressureથી filtration; solid-bowl sedimenting centrifugeથી જુદું.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Filtering element supported cloth/mediumવાળું perforated rotating basket (1) છે. Shaft, bearings/rated drive (2) basketને ફેરવે; બહાર protective casing તથા lid interlock (3) હોય છે. Approved distributor (4) feed આપે. Stationary casing basketમાંથી આવેલ liquidને filtrate outlet (5) તરફ લઈ જાય છે.

Inner retaining surface પર cake (6) બને છે. Discharge complete stop પછી manual કે engineered automatic arrangementથી હોઈ શકે. Basket strength, max speed/load balance critical છે. આ permeable basketવાળું filtering centrifuge છે; filter mediumમાંથી passage વગર separation કરતું solid-bowl settling centrifuge નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Approved balanced load સાથે rotation liquid/solidsને basket wall તરફ લઈ જાય છે. Outward pressure gradient liquidને cake, cloth તથા perforationsમાંથી પસાર કરે છે. Mediumમાંથી ન પસાર થનારા solids અંદર cake બનાવે; filtrate stationary casingમાંથી અલગ outletમાં જાય છે.

Rotation cakeમાં retained liquidનો ભાગ દૂર કરે; specified હોય તો designed wash મળે. Cake thickness/liquid radii બદલાતાં flow બદલાય એટલે planar constant-pressure equation આપમેળે લાગુ નથી. અંતે stop, verified zero speed તથા isolation પછી જ opening/cake removal થાય. Centrifugal headને thick cake પર universal constant ΔP ન માનવું.

ઉપયોગો

  • સારી drainageવાળા crystalline/granular cakeનું dewatering.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Overspeed, unbalance/rotor failure ગંભીર; interlock bypass/improvised rotor નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Sedimentation separates particles from a fluid by gravity; terminal velocity is the steady relative speed when net force is zero.

Classification

  • Free settling:isolated particles with negligible interference. Hindered settling:neighbouring particles/counterflow affect motion in concentrated suspensions.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. For an isolated sphere of diameter d in a quiescent Newtonian fluid, volume vp=πd³/6.Assume ρp>ρf, negligible wall/interparticle effects and creeping flow.
  2. Downward weight W=ρpvp g; upward buoyancy Fb=ρfvp g.The net gravitational driving force is(W−Fb)=(ρp−ρf)πd³g/6.
  3. At terminal velocity acceleration is zero, so drag Fd=W−Fb.For Stokes flow, Fd=3πμdvt.
  4. Equate forces:3πμdvt=(ρp−ρf)πd³g/6.Cancel πd and rearrange:vt=(ρp−ρf)gd²/(18μ).
  5. After calculating vt, verify Rep=ρfvt d/μ≪1.If not, use a suitable drag correlation rather than accepting the Stokes answer.
  6. For a general drag law, Fd=(1/2)CDρf(πd²/4)vt².Force balance gives vt=√[4gd(ρp−ρf)/(3ρfCD)]; CD depends on Re, so iteration may be needed.
  7. Hindered settling introduces neighbouring-particle and liquid-counterflow effects; it cannot be obtained simply by inserting bulk density into this isolated-sphere formula.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Gravityથી fluidમાંથી particles અલગ કરવું sedimentation; net force શૂન્ય થાય તે steady relative speed terminal velocity.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Free settlingમાં interference નગણ્ય; hindered settlingમાં concentrated suspensionના neighbours/counterflow અસર કરે.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Quiescent Newtonian fluidમાં isolated sphere d માટે vp=πd³/6; ρp>ρf, negligible wall/interparticle effects તથા creeping flow માનો.
  2. Weight W=ρpvp g નીચે, buoyancy Fb=ρfvp g ઉપર; driving force=(ρp−ρf)πd³g/6.
  3. Terminal velocityએ acceleration zero એટલે Fd=W−Fb.Stokes flowમાં Fd=3πμdvt.
  4. Forces equate:3πμdvt=(ρp−ρf)πd³g/6; πd cancel/rearrange કરતાં vt=(ρp−ρf)gd²/(18μ).
  5. vt પછી Rep=ρfvt d/μ≪1 ચકાસો; ન હોય તો suitable drag correlation લો, Stokes answer સ્વીકારી ન લો.
  6. General dragમાં Fd=(1/2)CDρf(πd²/4)vt²; balanceથી vt=√[4gd(ρp−ρf)/(3ρfCD)].CD(Re) હોવાથી iteration જોઈએ.
  7. Hindered settlingમાં neighbouring particles/counterflow અસર કરે; isolated formulaમાં bulk density મૂકવાથી તેનો યોગ્ય ઉકેલ મળતો નથી.

Definition

A batch settling test follows the position of a visible suspension interface with time in a quiescent cylinder.

Explanation

  • Initially the suspension may settle as a zone; clear liquid grows above it and solids concentrate below.
  • Plot interface height H against time t; the negative local slope−dH/dt is the interface settling rate.
  • A near-linear early section may represent zone settling; later compression gives a curved approach to ultimate height H∞.
  • If all solid remains in a constant-area cylinder, C0H0=C∞H∞.This mass balance alone does not design a continuous thickener.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

સ્થિર cylinderમાં visible suspension interfaceની height સમય સાથે નોંધવી batch settling test છે.

સમજણ

  • શરૂઆતમાં zone settling; ઉપર clear liquid અને નીચે concentrated solids.
  • H સામે t plot; negative local slope−dH/dt interface settling rate.
  • પ્રારંભિક linear ભાગ zone settling; પછી compressionથી curve ultimate H∞ તરફ જાય.
  • બધા solids constant-area cylinderમાં રહે તો C0H0=C∞H∞.આથી એકલા continuous thickener design થતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A continuous settling vessel producing clarified overflow and concentrated slurry underflow.

Principle

  • Gravity settling and bed compression increase underflow concentration.

Construction—detailed theory

A gravity thickener is a wide tank with an inlet feedwell (1), a peripheral overflow weir/launder (2), and a sloping lower region holding concentrated solids (4). A slow rake mechanism (3) operates near the floor to guide settled solids towards the underflow outlet (5). The large area provides time and area for settling.

The rake drive includes suitable torque protection (6), because dense beds can resist movement. The feedwell dissipates inlet momentum and distributes slurry without excessive disturbance. Overflow and underflow have separate outlets. Rakes are slow solids-transport devices, not high-speed impellers intended to resuspend the entire solids bed.

Working—detailed theory

Slurry enters the feedwell and spreads into the settling region. Particles settle relative to the liquid, while clarified liquid moves towards the surface overflow. At appreciable solids concentration, particles interact and may settle as a zone rather than as isolated spheres; a dilute Stokes velocity alone is therefore insufficient to describe the whole thickener.

Settled solids accumulate and compress in the lower bed. Slowly rotating rakes move them towards the withdrawal point, and controlled underflow removes the concentrated slurry. Clarified overflow leaves around the weir. Feed rate, settling characteristics, bed inventory and underflow rate must balance; uncontrolled rake agitation would disturb clarification instead of improving it.

Applications

  • Slurry concentration and clarification before further dewatering.

Limitations and safety

  • Hydraulic and solids-flux limits both matter. Rake overload/entry into vessels needs strict controls.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Clarified overflow તથા concentrated slurry underflow આપતું continuous settling vessel.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Gravity settling/bed compressionથી underflow concentration વધે.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Gravity thickenerમાં wide tank, feedwell (1), peripheral overflow weir/launder (2) તથા concentrated solidsવાળો sloping lower region (4) હોય છે. Floor નજીક slow rake (3) settled solidsને underflow outlet (5) તરફ ખસેડે છે. મોટું area settling માટે area/time આપે છે.

Dense bedના resistanceને લીધે rake driveમાં torque protection (6) હોય છે. Feedwell inlet momentum ઘટાડીને slurryને વધુ disturbance વિના ફેલાવે છે. Overflow/underflowના outlets જુદાં છે. Rakes slow solids-transport devices છે; આખો bed resuspend કરતા high-speed impellers નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Slurry feedwellમાંથી settling regionમાં ફેલાય છે. Particles liquidની સરખામણીએ નીચે જાય; clarified liquid surface overflow તરફ જાય છે. વધુ concentrationમાં particles interact કરી zone તરીકે settle થાય, isolated spheresની જેમ નહીં. તેથી માત્ર dilute Stokes velocityથી આખું thickener વર્ણવી શકાતું નથી.

Settled solids lower bedમાં જમા/compress થાય. Slow rotating rakes તેને withdrawal point તરફ લઈ જાય; controlled underflow concentrated slurry દૂર કરે. Clarified overflow weirથી નીકળે છે. Feed rate, settling properties, bed inventory/underflow rate સંતુલિત હોવા જોઈએ; uncontrolled agitation clarification બગાડે છે.

ઉપયોગો

  • આગળના dewatering પહેલાં slurry concentration/clarification.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Hydraulic/solids-flux બંને limits; overload તથા vessel entry માટે કડક controls.

body.en:
Definition

A separator using a swirling gas flow to collect entrained particles; not the same device as a liquid hydrocyclone.

Principle

  • Inertia drives suitable particles to the wall while gas forms an outer downward and inner upward vortex.

Construction—detailed theory

A gas–solid cyclone consists of a tangential dirty-gas inlet (1), cylindrical barrel (2) and conical lower body (3). A central vortex finder leads to the clean-gas outlet (4). The cone ends in a dust discharge connected to a suitably sealed receiver (5). Enclosed ducts and supports complete the installation (6).

The tangential entry creates swirl without a rotating impeller inside the cyclone. The vortex finder projects into the barrel to collect the inner returning gas stream. Receiver sealing prevents air leakage and dust re-entrainment. The sketch is a gas–solid collector, not a liquid hydrocyclone; fan power elsewhere overcomes its pressure loss.

Working—detailed theory

Dust-laden gas enters tangentially and follows a descending outer spiral near the barrel and cone walls. Inertial effects make sufficiently responsive particles migrate outward relative to the turning gas. Contact with the wall and loss of momentum promote their movement towards the lower dust outlet. Very fine particles may remain closely coupled to the gas and escape collection.

The gas reverses direction in the lower region and forms an inner rising vortex, leaving through the vortex finder. Collected solids pass into the sealed receiver. Separation depends on geometry, gas rate, particle size/density and re-entrainment; higher pressure loss is not by itself proof of better useful performance. Collection efficiency must state whether it is overall mass efficiency or size-specific grade efficiency.

Applications

  • Coarse dust recovery and precleaning before finer collectors.

Limitations and safety

  • Very fine dust may escape. Avoid silica/combustible-dust demonstrations; no open powder blowing.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Swirling gasથી entrained particles એકત્ર કરતું separator; liquid hydrocycloneથી જુદું.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Inertiaથી particles wall તરફ; gasમાં outer downward/inner upward vortex.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Gas–solid cycloneમાં tangential dirty-gas inlet (1), cylindrical barrel (2), conical lower body (3) અને central vortex finder/clean-gas outlet (4) હોય છે. Coneના dust discharge સાથે suitably sealed receiver (5) જોડાય છે. Enclosed ducts/supports (6) installation પૂર્ણ કરે છે.

Tangential entryથી અંદર rotating impeller વિના swirl બને છે. Vortex finder barrelમાં અંદર સુધી જઈ inner returning gas લે છે. Receiver sealingથી air leakage/dust re-entrainment ઘટે છે. આ gas–solid collector છે, liquid hydrocyclone નહીં. External fan power તેની pressure loss હરાવે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Dust-laden gas tangentially આવી barrel/cone walls પાસે descending outer spiral બનાવે છે. Turning gasની સરખામણીએ inertial effectsથી યોગ્ય particles બહાર તરફ migrate થાય છે. Wall contact તથા momentum lossથી particles lower dust outlet તરફ જાય. ખૂબ fines gas સાથે રહી collectionમાંથી છૂટી શકે છે.

Lower regionમાં gas direction બદલી inner rising vortex બનાવે અને vortex finderથી નીકળે છે. Collected solids sealed receiverમાં જાય. Geometry, gas rate, size/density/re-entrainmentથી separation બદલાય; વધારે pressure loss પોતે સારી performanceનો પુરાવો નથી. Efficiency overall mass કે size-specific grade છે તે સ્પષ્ટ જણાવવું.

ઉપયોગો

  • Coarse dust recovery તથા fine collector પહેલાં precleaning.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • ખૂબ fine dust રહી શકે. Silica/combustible-dust demo તથા open powder blowing નહીં.

Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

For one constant-pressure test, t/V intercept B=1000s/m³ and slope K=2.0×10⁵s/m⁶.A=0.10m², ΔP=50000Pa, μ=0.001Pa·s, C=100kg dry cake solid/m³ filtrate.

To find

Calculate Rm, α, time at a specified V, and instantaneous versus average rate.

Governing relation and assumptions

Uniform incompressible cake, constant ΔP:t/V=B+KV; Rm=BAΔP/μ; α=2KA²ΔP/(μC); qinst=1/(B+2KV).C is deposited dry solids per filtrate volume.

Calculation with substitution

  1. Rm=BAΔP/μ=5.0×10⁹m⁻¹.
  2. α=2KA²ΔP/(μC)=2.0×10⁹m/kg.
  3. At V=0.010m³, t=BV+KV²=10+20=30s.
  4. Instantaneous dV/dt=1/(B+2KV)=0.0002m³/s; average V/t=0.000333m³/s. These are not equal.

Final answer

Rm=5.0×10⁹m⁻¹; α=2.0×10⁹m/kg; t=30s; qinst=2.00×10⁻⁴m³/s; qavg=3.33×10⁻⁴m³/s.

Unit/physical check

BV=10s and KV²=20s; both have time units.The falling rate makes the endpoint instantaneous rate lower than the average.

Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

Liquid density1000kg/m³ rotates at600rpm between free-surface radius r1=0.10m and outer radius r2=0.20m. Assume rigid-body rotation.

To find

Calculate available centrifugal liquid head, not an unqualified cake pressure.

Governing relation and assumptions

For rigid-body liquid rotation, dp/dr=ρω²r.Integrating r1→r2 gives ΔP=ρω²(r2²−r1²)/2; ω=2πrpm/60.

Calculation with substitution

  1. ω=2π×600/60=62.832rad/s.
  2. ΔP=ρ ω²(r2²−r1²)/2=59217.6Pa≈59.22kPa.
  3. This is available liquid head, not automatically pressure across the whole cake. Thickness, changing radii and radial area require the validated centrifuge model.
  4. No operating speed recommendation is implied; actual apparatus rating and balance govern.

Final answer

ω≈62.832rad/s; ΔP≈59217.6Pa=59.22kPa.

Unit/physical check

r2>r1 makes ΔP positive; kg/m³×s⁻²×m²=Pa.Thick radial cake and changing radii require a validated model.

Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

H falls from0.30m to0.21m in the initial180s linear zone; H∞=0.15m. Initial dry-solid concentration C0=100kg/m³.

To find

Find initial zone-settling velocity and final bed concentration.

Governing relation and assumptions

In the stated linear zone, vz=−ΔH/Δt.For a constant-area cylinder with no solids loss, C0AH0=C∞AH∞.

Calculation with substitution

  1. Zone-settling velocity=−ΔH/Δt=(0.30−0.21)/180=0.0005m/s.
  2. Constant cylinder area and no solid loss:C∞H∞=C0H0.
  3. C∞=100×0.30/0.15=200kg/m³ settled bed. Not the true particle density.

Final answer

vz=0.0005m/s; C∞=200kg dry solids/m³ settled bed.

Unit/physical check

H∞ is half H0, so final concentration doubles.This is suspension/bed concentration, not particle density.

body.en:
Aim and scope

  • Measure centrifugal filtration rate; determine cake/media resistance only with the apparatus-validated model and stated assumptions.

Instruments/materials

  • Rated interlocked filtering basket trainer, matched balanced loads, approved medium/slurry, timer, receiver, balance, speed indication and validated model sheet.

Connections/setup

  • Instructor seats supported medium, checks rated basket/locking and balances loads to the specified tolerance; route filtrate to guarded receiver.

Procedure

  1. Record basket radii, filter area, slurry/medium and authorised speed; verify lid interlock without bypass.
  2. Start only as authorised; record cumulative V, t and speed through the external indicators.
  3. Stop, wait for verified zero rotation and isolate before opening or weighing cake.
  4. Use validated radial/variable-head model. If the instructor explicitly approves a thin-layer constant-effective-head approximation, identify fitted resistances as apparent.

Blank observation sheet

  • Time ___s, V ___m³, speed ___rpm, inner liquid radius ___m, outer radius ___m, A ___m², μ ___Pa·s, C ___kg/m³, model/version ___, cake dry mass ___kg.

Calculations and blank result

  • Rate=ΔV/Δt; liquid head estimate ΔP=ρω²(r2²−r1²)/2, ω=2πrpm/60, not automatically cake ΔP.
  • Only if the validated thin-layer model applies:t/V=B+KV; Rm, app=BAΔPeff/μ; αapp=2KA²ΔPeff/(μC). Otherwise use the supplied radial model or report insufficient data.
  • Result:rate ___m³/s; Rm ___m⁻¹, α ___m/kg; model/limitations ___; do not label an invalid planar fit as true resistance.

Safe fault-finding

  • Vibration/abnormal sound:use normal emergency procedure, stand clear and notify instructor; after zero speed/isolation staff check balance, basket, medium and bearings.

Precautions

  • Use only the instructor-approved guarded trainer and compatible nonhazardous sample; record apparatus ID and authorised settings.
  • Isolate electrical/mechanical/pressure energy before opening, adjusting or clearing equipment; an emergency stop is not isolation.
  • Wear specified PPE, control dust/spills and follow the laboratory waste procedure; do not improvise live fault tests.
  • Never bypass interlock, open rotating lid, use damaged baskets or change rated speed to improve filtration.
